turns.content: This Postgres query double-counts revenue when an order has several shipments: SELECT o.id, SUM(o.total) FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id. How do I fix it without losing orders that have no shipments?

The join repeats each order once per shipment, so SUM(o.total) counts it several times. Aggregate orders on their own and join shipments only for what you need: SELECT o.id, o.total, COUNT(s.id) AS shipments FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id, o.total. The LEFT JOIN keeps orders with no shipments.
